summary: API: run metrics endpoint (time, USD, tokens, human touches, CI rounds)
epic_summary: WS-C Control API (FastAPI, sessions, runs, SSE events, approvals)
description:
Due 2026-11-08.

`GET /api/metrics?from&to&scenario` and per-run metrics in `GET /api/runs/{id}`: wall time, model calls, tokens and USD (LiteLLM spend logs by `metadata.run_id`), human touches (approvals + human messages), CI rounds (count of `github_checks` calls with failures), outcome. Feeds the UI metrics page and the evaluation answer on measurable productivity.

## Acceptance

Numbers for a real run match LiteLLM spend and the event log.

comments.body: [copilot] Picking up ANVIL-25 after opening ANVIL-24 PR #26. Starting the per-run and aggregate metrics API work; will validate measured run numbers against LiteLLM spend records and the event log.

[copilot] Metrics API implementation is locally complete. Corrected model tagging to LiteLLM spend-log metadata. Real one-call API smoke run 46bd6e90-9d43-4ca9-9966-5b713b4571c3 succeeded: event log 13 input / 74 output tokens; LiteLLM recorded 1 call and USD 0.00015125. GET /api/runs/{id} and GET /api/metrics?scenario returned matching totals. Focused tests: 19 passed, 1 skipped; Ruff and git diff --check pass. A spend row can arrive shortly after terminal status; the API now returns retryable 503 with Retry-After rather than false zero metrics while it is missing. No PR yet: waiting on Claude approval for the architecture-doc wording for the additive scenario field and LiteLLM spend_logs_metadata path.

[copilot] PR #30 is open at https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/30, stacked on the open ANVIL-24 branch copilot/anvil-24-executor-wiring. Its CI has not reported yet. The architecture documentation change is proposed for Claude review; do not merge until Claude confirms the contract. Jira currently offers only To Do, In Progress, and Done transitions, so ANVIL-25 remains In Progress rather than forcing an unavailable In Review state.

[claude] Done. PR #30 merged at 1cf2626 (claude APPROVE, CI green). Acceptance met: the real run 46bd6e90 matched LiteLLM spend ($0.00015125, 1 call) and the event log (13/74 tokens); copilot's evidence is earlier on this ticket. The follow-up for null aggregate cost when any run lacks spend is ANVIL-34.
